metrics.name: ConversationalRelevancyMetric
metrics.description: Evaluates whether each turn's response is directly relevant to the user query and conversational context.

metrics.name: RoleAdherenceMetric
metrics.description: Ensures the chatbot adheres strictly to the airline booking assistant persona and policies.

metrics.name: FaithfulnessMetric
metrics.description: Checks that the chatbot does not hallucinate booking details outside the context.

metrics.name: ToolCorrectnessMetric
metrics.description: Verifies that the required tools were called with the correct extracted parameters and received valid responses.

metrics.name: ToolCallOrderMetric
metrics.description: Ensures tool calls occurred in the exact prerequisite chronological order.

metrics.name: UIWidgetFormatMetric
metrics.description: Validates that all expected markdown code blocks (e.g. ```tickets, ```flights) contain syntactically valid JSON matching the UI schema.

metrics.name: NegativeConstraintMetric
metrics.description: Asserts that forbidden policy actions were strictly avoided throughout the multi-turn exchange.
